versions.changelog: Repo renamed: SagaSmith-skill → SagaSmith-skills. README now English with comprehensive 8-phase examples.
Updated README with comprehensive 8-phase usage examples and README-cn.md

Initial release of sagasmith: an autonomous D&D 5e AI Dungeon Master skill suite.

- Bundles dnd-dm, dnd-campaign-manager, and dnd-module-gen for a full-featured DM experience.
- Supports campaign lifecycle management, adventure module generation (5 types × 25 paradigms), and rule adjudication.
- Features an immersive DM persona: Minthara Baenre, upholding strict 2024 rulebook standards.
- Includes database snapshotting, SRD 5.2.1 integration (English and Chinese), and cross-platform support (NanoBot, OpenClaw, Hermes).
